d.ko: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

d.zh: 一款每个抉择都至关重要的肉鸽冰球游戏，踏上打造最强冰球队的征程！选择你的路线，招募各具特色的球员，发掘队员之间的强力羁绊，挑选独特技能，贿赂裁判，或是拜访装备大师，让冰球重现昔日荣光！

rv.t: It's a silly little hockey game but with this format its almost like a different kind of playoff run. This game is stupid fun, have a controller. Speaking from a NHL 94/Mutant League Hockey fanatic.
As a Canadian who grew up playing the NHL games on the PS3, Its like this game was made for me. Recommended to any other Canadians.

Lots of potential. The "AI" positioning makes solo play infuriatingly unplayable. Or just score first and sit your own zone with puck and wait for the game to end since the AI never leaves the neutral zone....
一代人有一代人的热血足球！ 大概就是这么个感觉，花样更多的热血足球（说是热血冰球也行） 有手柄的直接用手柄，不要用键盘玩。 简单难度比较好打，可惜不解锁什么东西，上来爽一下还行。 …
好玩！! ! 在这款以冰球为主题的单人合作类游戏，前期一控多玩着有点不习惯，掌握后可以按你想做的去拉锯，对面虽然是人机，是有挑战性的，对手队友落位和正常球类运动一样，除了自己撞到自己队友，队友人机是不会影响你的操作相反还很趁手，一步步打开局 …
难度曲线，操作设计都堪称垃圾。
